items.title: PSA: Those of you who want to ride asap... download the new update after you ride!
items.text:
PSA: Those of you who want to ride asap... download the new update after you ride!
Haven’t rode  all week due to food poisoning... ugh! 

Anyhow, today is the day and I’m ready to roll but, this update is taking foreverrrrrrr!!!!  I’ve been in the holding pattern for at least 15 min!!!! 

I wish I had waited to download until after this ride! 

Tick tock... my time to get my ride in is dwindling!!!

Hope this helps some other gungho ready to roll motivated riders!!!

Ride on pelly peeps!
I missed my work out because it took way too long. I’m happy they are updating the bike, but it said it would take only 5 min and it took 30!

Oh no!!!!

Did you contact support?

My fingers are crossed that I can go go go!!!!!!!!

Ugh!!!!! Why mess with something when it’s great to begin with?

I wish they would tell us what benefit we are receiving when we do these upgrades. 

I remember the great calibration fiasco in the fall of ‘18 (I think.. but maybe it was ‘17). That didn’t mess with the function of the machine, but really changed my feeling of superiority!!! Hahah! My output and calories plummeted!!!

Just finished a ride... The only issue I had was the announcement that some
Rider hit the 20 in a row milestone... that appeared about 6 times, but other than that it’s the same wonderful bike!!!
